name: cheat-picture-viewer
title: Cheat menu: "Show Colony Sites" (an empty stub) becomes the hidden Picture Viewer
why: The developers' picture viewer, debug_picture_viewer (1040:46aa), asks "View which
picture #?" and shows any of 107 CVPC pictures or SPRT sprites in a 640x480 window. Its
command (811) is dispatched but no menu item carries it. Meanwhile the Cheat menu's
"Show Colony Sites" (809) calls show_colony_sites (1048:b92c), whose body is empty.
In the command dispatcher the 809 arm (`push cs / call near show_colony_sites /
jmp near exit`) sits 14 bytes before the 811 arm (`call far debug_picture_viewer /
jmp near exit`). A 2-byte `jmp short` at the head of the 809 arm lands on the 811 arm,
so no relocation is added. The menu label is a DGROUP string used only by
cheat_menu_toggle; it is rewritten in place, NUL-padded to its original 18 bytes.
test: In a game, type Ctrl+W, Ctrl+I, Ctrl+N to raise the Cheat menu.
Cheat > Picture Viewer. Enter a number 0..106 (e.g. 5). A 640x480 window titled
"Close Window to Reset Palette" shows the picture; close it and the map's colours return.
A number outside 0..106 closes at once. The other Cheat items are unchanged.
status: bytes and behaviour checked; not yet confirmed in play

sites.note: 809 arm -> jump to the 811 arm at 1048:c94d
